{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living record of all fresh ideas generated by the team. It is intended to capture, organize, and prioritize ideas for future development.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for exploring the idea.
- **Priority** – 1 (low) to 5 (high).
- **Status** – Proposed / In Review / Approved / Rejected.
- **Notes** – Additional comments or references.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Open this file in your preferred editor.
2. Append a new entry following the structure above.
3. Save and commit changes to the repository.

---
Feel free to add more sections or modify the template as needed.
"}

{"terminal_output": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living record of all fresh ideas generated by the team. It is intended to capture, organize, and prioritize ideas for future development.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for exploring the idea.
- **Priority** – 1 (low) to 5 (high).
- **Status** – Proposed / In Review / Approved / Rejected.
- **Notes** – Additional comments or references.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Open this file in your preferred editor.
2. Append a new entry following the structure above.
3. Save and commit changes to the repository.

---
Feel free to add more sections or modify the template as needed.
"}

{"terminal_output": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living record of all fresh ideas generated by the team. It is intended to capture, organize, and prioritize ideas for future development.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for exploring the idea.
- **Priority** – 1 (low) to 5 (high).
- **Status** – Proposed / In Review / Approved / Rejected.
- **Notes** – Additional comments or references.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Open this file in your preferred editor.
2. Append a new entry following the structure above.
3. Save and commit changes to the repository.

---
Feel free to add more sections or modify the template as needed.
"}

{"terminal_output": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living record of all fresh ideas generated by the team. It is intended to capture, organize, and prioritize ideas for future development.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for exploring the idea.
- **Priority** – 1 (low) to 5 (high).
- **Status** – Proposed / In Review / Approved / Rejected.
- **Notes** – Additional comments or references.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Open this file in your preferred editor.
2. Append a new entry following the structure above.
3. Save and commit changes to the repository.

---
Feel free to add more sections or modify the template as needed.
"}

## Purpose
This document serves as a living record of all fresh ideas generated by the team. It is intended to capture, organize, and prioritize ideas for future development.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for exploring the idea.
- **Priority** – 1 (low) to 5 (high).
- **Status** – Proposed / In Review / Approved / Rejected.
- **Notes** – Additional comments or references.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Open this file in your preferred editor.
2. Append a new entry following the structure above.
3. Save and commit changes to the repository.

---
Feel free to add more sections or modify the template as needed.
"}

{"terminal_output": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living record of all fresh ideas generated by the team. It is intended to capture, organize, and prioritize ideas for future development.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for exploring the idea.
- **Priority** – 1 (low) to 5 (high).
- **Status** – Proposed / In Review / Approved / Rejected.
- **Notes** – Additional comments or references.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Open this file in your preferred editor.
2. Append a new entry following the structure above.
3. Save and commit changes to the repository.

---
Feel free to add more sections or modify the template as needed.
"}

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for exploring the idea.
- **Priority** – 1 (low) to 5 (high).

---

{"terminal_output": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living record of all fresh ideas generated by the team. It is intended to capture, organize, and prioritize ideas for future development.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for exploring the idea.
- **Priority** – 1 (low) to 5 (high).
- **Status** – Proposed / In Review / Approved / Rejected.
- **Notes** – Additional comments or references.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Open this file in your preferred editor.
2. Append a new entry following the structure above.
3. Save and commit changes to the repository.

---
Feel free to add more sections or modify the template as needed.
"}

---

"}

{"terminal_output": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living record of all fresh ideas generated by the team. It is intended to capture, organize, and prioritize ideas for future development.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
- **Title** – Short descriptive title.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
- **Owner** – Person responsible for exploring the idea.
- **Priority** – 1 (low) to 5 (high).
- **Status** – Proposed / In Review / Approved / Rejected.
- **Notes** – Additional comments or references.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Open this file in your preferred editor.
2. Append a new entry following the structure above.
3. Save and commit changes to the repository.

---
Feel free to add more sections or modify the template as needed.
"}
